bible.title: Return to the Ford
bible.kernel: A steward hires mercenaries to bring back an exile who reappeared at the ford. The exile's return forces a clash with the lord who once banished her.

cast.name: Lothiel Fernbrook
cast.who: steward of the river ford and its small household, keeper of the ford's receipts.
cast.want: to have the exile returned alive to her at the ford

cast.name: Elaninwe
cast.who: an elf exile who has come back into the Western Forests after years away.
cast.want: to keep her chest of foreign coin

cast.name: Osgar the Younger
cast.who: the young lord who once banished the elf and still lays claim to the forest hunting rights.
cast.want: to seize the exile and recover his hunting rights

bible.situation: Lothiel Fernbrook hires the company to find and return the exile who reappeared at the river ford so the exile can answer the terms of banishment.
bible.goal: to capture and return alive the exile who reappeared at the river ford to Lothiel Fernbrook
arc: Search the river ford's shallows for signs of the exile seen there → yields: a mud-stained silk ribbon threaded with a centipede bead and a trail leading into Silverbloom Hollow
Follow the trail into the Western Forests and locate the camp the ribbon leads to at Silverbloom Hollow → yields: Elaninwe's camp and a chest of foreign coin

Secure the exile and prepare to move her back toward the ford while watching the routes Osgar would use → yields: a hunting horn stamped with Osgar the Younger's crest, showing he rides to intercept at the ford
Bring Elaninwe to the river ford for Lothiel to receive while Osgar arrives to stop delivery. Buy him off with a portion of the chest and hand Elaninwe over to Lothiel at the ford
bible.twist: Elaninwe returned with foreign coin and pledges enough to buy the woodsmen's support and outmatch Osgar's local claims.
tensions: Osgar will move to seize the exile and press his claim to the ford's rights
Elaninwe's new wealth tempts the forest crews to side with her instead of the lord
Lothiel's legal power at the ford is thin without the exile in her hands
openDirections: If the company delays, local crews may sell their pledges to the highest bidder and change which side controls the ford.
bible.stakeIfLost: If the company fails, Lothiel loses the ferry and hunting rights at the ford, and her household will be forced from its holding when the lord reclaims them.
bible.arrival: came down from higher ground · asked for the boss by name

shipped.title: Search the ford shallows
shipped.situation: A steward of the river ford, Lothiel Fernbrook, came down from higher ground and told you the ford had an unwanted guest. She warns that if you fail, the lord will reclaim the holding and she will lose the ferry and hunting rights at the ford. She wants the exile returned alive and asks you to search the river ford's shallows for signs of the exile seen there, the fee fixed and what else shakes loose the company keeps. The noble Osgar the Younger intends to seize the exile and recover his hunting rights. She wiped her hands on her coat as she repeated the ask.
shipped.job: Find any sign of the exile in the river ford's shallows.
